reviews.title: Great step up if you need a newer card.
reviews.comment: Got this graphics card in November and it has been running like a champ. Overclocking is no issues with it, Same with undervolting.  It's a huge step up from my previous card, which was the RX 6700 XT. It stays cool under load and I can barely hear the fans when they ramp up. Was worth ever cent I paid.
